ResolveToken immediately consumes scalar svError into mnError/mfValue; after mnError NONE only matrix upper-left can yield svError, so three error query bodies specialize the redundant direct stored error-token guards. GetType returns svDouble for non-token nonempty nonerror states, so GetResult non-token string guard after isValue is provably unreachable and removed, not coverage-ignored or exercised through fake private state. Complete original native class/header/source and genuine dependencies compare public state/copy/import/cache/alias/output histories normally only. ABI/assertions/native ownership counts/concurrency/full original QA unverified. ScFormulaCell/storage/document/editing/UI/ODS remain pending real owners; UI/ODS priority and full91 retained.
